name: J-Tool (thumb-turn bypass)
description: The J-tool is a long, flexible instrument inserted through the door gap — typically augmented by an air wedge — to reach and rotate a thumb-turn lock on the interior side. It is effective on doors with sufficient frame clearance and works on a wide range of residential and light commercial thumb-turn configurations. A staple for hotel corridors, apartment buildings, and older commercial doors where thumb-turn deadbolts are used without additional security hardware.

blue.det: Tool visible through door gap; door open alert; camera footage.
blue.cm: Door bottom and side seals minimizing gap; thumb turn guards; door alarms; double-cylinder deadbolts (keyed both sides) prevent thumb-turn bypass.
